title: IT Glue (unofficial)
auth: API key in the x-api-key header, from a key without password access, and the data center's API host as a connection setting
author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: Not run against IT Glue: there was no account to test with. On 2026-10-21 a renamed copy imported into a Sophos Fusion tenant, exported again, and was deleted. IT Glue's name filter matches the whole name, so a hostname that differs in its domain part won't match.
